description: "Hope and Have; or, Fanny Grant Among the Indians: A Story for Young People" by Oliver Optic is a novel for young readers written in the mid-19th century. The story follows Fanny Grant, a young girl who undergoes a transformation from being a wayward child to a more responsible person.
